name: xn-qol-enhancements
author: [sky[]]Xnuui
description:
[white[]]Features in this mod were listed as [#EF4444[]]PRs[white[]] a while ago. But [#EF4444[]]Anuke[white[]], to this day, has not decided to merge them in, so i made a mod about it

[#EF4444[]]INCLUDED FEATURES:
[#FFF000[]]1. Phase Bridge Autolink [#EF4444[]](DRAGGING)
[#88C6ED[]]Works like normal bridges when you drag, but with phase bridges supported too

[#FFF000[]]2. Belt-on-Junction Fix
[#88C6ED[]]Lets players move a conduit line over a junction without turning it back into a normal conduit.

[#82C341[]]3. Total Schematic Size Display
[#88C6ED[]]Displays the total schematic size when opening a schematic

[#FAA31B[]]4. Heat Decimal Display
[#88C6ED[]]Displays heat as a decimal only when there is one
